meta.title: Everest climbing decision support
caveats: The snapshot ends in 2024; the 2026 spring figures are a separate, clearly labelled layer and are not merged into any modelling data.
The source has no camp coordinates or route geometry. The camp altitude profile is built from the campsite text field; the terrain view uses SRTM elevation and OpenStreetMap camp positions.
Member-level year is taken from the expedition record because the member table's own year field disagrees with its expedition in 34.8% of rows (96% before 2000).
